basis: Manual image picks on the supplied photograph, paired with the existing simplified typical-floor polygon. Roof and floor edges are interpreted correspondences, not surveyed control points. The image may have been cropped or corrected; its lens metadata and distortion are unknown. Terrace-top correspondences now refer to the revised provisional band tops, rather than the R5 floor plane.
